## isKeyRevoked() function

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Use [getKeyRecordStatus()](./runtime.getkeyrecordstatus.md)<!-- -->; `isKeyRevoked(id)` equals `getKeyRecordStatus(id) === 'revoked'`<!-- -->.

Check whether a key id has a stored record that is marked revoked.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function isKeyRevoked(keyId: string): boolean
```

**Returns:**

boolean

True if the key has a stored record and it is revoked

## Remarks

Never use this to decide whether a key may be used. It returns `false` for a key with no stored record, which validation refuses. It answers only "is there a stored record marked revoked". Use `validateApiKey` to authorize a key, and [getKeyRecordStatus()](./runtime.getkeyrecordstatus.md) to tell active, revoked and missing keys apart.
